corrections.reason: Joining across the line wrap to L25 (ል) forms the standard Andemta citation marker እንዲል; the right-foot vowel stroke of ዲ is visible on the page.
The third character of አርአዮሙ is clearly a 1st-order አ (matching the initial አ) without the center loop of እ.
The final glyph of ሕዋሳቶች is 6th-order ች (identical to ሕዋሳቶች on L35 above it), reading 'አምስቱ ሕዋሳቶች ካምስቱ ሕዋሳቶች አንድ ሁኖ'.
